component.name: Bulan
component.summary: Stream games from your PC, wherever you are

description.p: Bulan is a controller-first fork of Moonlight, built for the Steam Deck. It can stream games and other applications from another PC with Sunshine or GeForce Experience software installed.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video support
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support
Gamepad support with force feedback for up to 16 players
Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)
Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host

screenshot.caption: Host selection page showing local PCs

description.p: First Bulan alpha. Early, private software: the core loop works end to end, and polish and validation are ongoing.

ul.li: A custom controller-first interface built for the Steam Deck
First-run onboarding, host carousel, game library and settings shell
The Bulan design system, with its own motion and atmosphere
Streaming, discovery and pairing remain Moonlight's
